context: Request: fund formations in the firm's files that carry a key-person provision. Rubric: 1001-00002 (Ardent), 1003-00002 (Harrowgate), 1024-00002 (Driftwood), 1027-00002 (Pellegrino), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a depth-limited find that returns nothing.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two store-wide files-with-matches greps for request terms (hits are mostly emails) plus a find piped to grep over file paths cut at 240 lines by its own limit; the path list spans many matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Content greps for the provision term inside five candidate matters; three return nothing.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of the same five candidates.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads emails, drafts and an execution-version agreement from three candidates.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Greps inside four single documents; all return nothing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of three agreements.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Script extracts provision text from three agreements (about 313K characters).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide text scan for the provision term; times out, and its partial output names further matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of one matter from the scan output.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads that matter's amendment, analysis memo and two letters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three formation matters plus one amendment matter.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Search within a candidate matter's files → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The file-path search listed one qualifying matter, but it was never among the candidates opened; the other three were found and answered.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: Its file-path search listed one qualifying matter's formation and governing documents, but the five matters it chose to grep left that matter out and it never opened it.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a files-with-matches grep for the provision term; the hits are mostly emails.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Lists files of three matters from the grep hits, plus a broader store-wide grep (labelled by the store-wide search).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Three file-name globs for agreement and offering words plus a content grep limited to `**/*.docx` that returns nothing.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists files of three matters from the glob hits and reads one agreement (labelled by the listings).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of four agreements and memos from four candidates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of four agreements and a review memo at repeated offsets; one read past the end returns nothing.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four matters with an express provision.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: File-name globs listed all qualifying matters, but it opened only one of them and filled the answer with others.

first_error.why: The file-name globs just before listed three more qualifying matters, but the three matters it chose to list were others and it never opened those three.

other_errors.why: Asserted two matters outside the permitted set as qualifying.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Two store-wide files-with-matches greps for request terms; hits are mostly emails.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads six emails from two matters in the hits.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists every matter folder.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Store-wide grep for the provision term.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads three emails of one candidate and lists the files of two candidates (labelled by the reads).

stages.note: Content greps inside four candidate matters; three return nothing.

stages.note: Reads later sections of three agreements at repeated offsets.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide text scan for the provision term; times out with partial output.

stages.note: Reads the executed amendment, analysis memo and engagement letter of a matter from the scan output.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three formation matters and lists the amendment matter separately.

stages.stage: Finish the run

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List matter folders → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The file-name list showed all qualifying matters, but it opened only one of them early, set aside a later one, and added a non-qualifying matter.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: Its per-matter file-name list showed all qualifying matters, but the four it chose to grep included only one of them; it never opened two others and found the fourth only later.

other_errors.why: Read a qualifying matter's executed amendment and memo but set it aside as a post-formation amendment (evidence seen at [57]-[60]).
Asserted a matter outside the permitted set as qualifying.

divergence: All three failed at the same kind of step: after a search listed qualifying matters by file name, the agent chose a few candidates to grep or list and left some out (surfaced-not-opened at T0 stage 3, T1 stage 4, T2 stage 9). Content greps mostly matched emails only, which pushed every run to file-name hits. T1 and T2 also asserted non-qualifying matters, and T2 set aside one matter it had read.
